For 2027-28 a.y., for students enrolled to their first year in a Bachelor of Science or Law programme, tuition and fees at Bocconi are set at € 17,700 per year.

name.fr: Bulletins de notes de l'avant-dernière et de l'antépénultième année

evidence.quote: ID or passport (if you are extra-EU) Parents' ID or passport (if you are underaged). 3rd-last and 2nd-last year transcripts Test score report (at least one)

notes: Supplied pages do not include a page for the 'Economic and Social Sciences' programme; the closest Bachelor's programme page (BSc in Economics, L-33) is used for duration and language. The tuition figure of EUR 17,700/year is stated on the Fees page for first-year Bachelor of Science or Law students at Bocconi; the pages do not distinguish a separate fee for non-EU students, and it is an institution-wide figure tied to this level of study, not to the programme's group. The application deadline used is the first round for international applicants (Early Session); a second Winter Session (25 November 2026 – 26 January 2027) also exists for international applicants. The pages do not mention any pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, so the university's own Apply2B portal is used as the application channel.

note.fr: La sélection se fonde sur le score du test (55%) et la moyenne des deux avant-dernières années du lycée (45%); il faut passer le test Bocconi en ligne, le SAT ou l'ACT
note.en: Selection is based on the test score (55%) and the third-last and second-last year GPA (45%); you must take the Bocconi online test, SAT or ACT

evidence.quote: The evaluation of applicants is based solely on these two elements. Additional documents, such as recommendation letters, motivational letters, CVs, or résumés, will not be considered in the assessment process.

note.fr: Un score total inférieur à 17 au test Bocconi en ligne entraîne l'exclusion de la sélection
note.en: A total score lower than 17 on the Bocconi online test leads to exclusion from the selection

evidence.quote: Applicants who receive a total score (penalties included) lower than 17 will not be considered in the selection process.

note.fr: Il faut avoir au moins 17 ans au 1er septembre 2027; les moins de 18 ans non résidents en Italie doivent nommer un tuteur légal
note.en: You must be at least 17 as of 1 September 2027; applicants under 18 not resident in Italy must appoint a legal guardian

evidence.quote: students who are not Italian citizens and are not residents in Italy, and who will be under the age of 17 as of 1 September 2027 (born after 1 September 2010), cannot be considered for admission

note.fr: Il faut fournir un diplôme d'études secondaires valable pour l'accès aux études supérieures; pour les non-UE, un Statement of Comparability CIMEA ou une Declaration of Value peut être exigé
note.en: You must provide a secondary school diploma valid for access to higher education; for non-EU applicants a CIMEA Statement of Comparability or Declaration of Value may be required

evidence.quote: For non-EU citizens and when indicated in the admission portal, Statements of Comparability and Verification issued by CIMEA (the Italian NARIC Center) may be a compulsory requirement to complete the enrollment.
